repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T14:10Z · area b1-L (epic #35590 child; the maintainer set the fig. 41 direction on the epic).
Area: b1-L
Session: `session_01L6bhgTKEPqtmiK9SGpHsmW` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-kmk099
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: plugin-detail `RelatedList.tsx` and one new session-state file; plugin-list `conditions/` one new registered host component, `ListConditionControls.tsx` (a narrow-face option; the shared Discard button after #36026 lands), `index.tsx` (registration); app-shell `ListDraftActions.tsx` (uses the shared Discard); a few i18n keys in every locale; the regenerated SDUI manifest; record-page related-list docs and the plugin-detail README; tests, changeset. Not expected: `plugin-grid`, `RecordPageColumns.tsx`, `packages/spec`.
Container & model: `L`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening) (a new registry component key, one optional `ConditionChipRow` prop, new i18n keys; `RelatedListProps` unchanged; the seat runs the declaration-face L2)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, read on main `493ad095`, file `build-seat1/35892/premise.md` in the project folder): holds. The tab's table is already the list page's `object-grid`; header menu, cell editing, summary row, load-more and the bulk bar are existing host keys. `plugin-list` depends on `plugin-detail`, so the condition row reaches `RelatedList` through the registry, as `object-grid` already does; nothing is written twice.
Basis: card #35892 (the maintainer's words on Attio's related tabs, and fig. 41); epic #35590.
Scope, the seat's reading: the card's seven items and its 03:30Z update. The tab's title row, sort and filter, 「放弃」, the column-header menu, cell editing by the #35683 / #36023 rules, load-more with the whole-set summary row, the tab count unfiltered and the footer count filtered, the same bottom bulk bar when rows are selected (the 03:30Z update). Column widths stay remembered per person. The tab's sort and filter survive switching tabs and moving between page and drawer for the same record, and clear on refresh or another record. Grouped-by-status child lists draw no summary row, as on the list page. A summary-row choice is allowed and lasts this visit only, cleared by 「放弃」. This PR delivers #36023 leftover 2 (cell editing inside the related tab), shown in the PR body.
Open: #35601 made the tab remember the reader's sort; the card's acceptance says refresh returns to the default, and its own note says the maintainer has not decided how long changes last. That flips merged behaviour, so it goes to the maintainer; the thread builds "this visit only" as the card states until then.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: parallel with #35890 (it places the tabs, this card draws their content). Merges main after #36024 lands; the shared Discard waits for #36026. `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. L1 at L1-b. The PR carries `Fixes #35892`.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T14:25Z · #35892: how long a related tab's sort and filter last (reviewed by fable first)

At 2026-11-21T14:25Z the maintainer picked option A on the seat's decision card, "this visit only": a sort or filter changed in a record page's related-list tab applies at once, stays while the reader switches tabs or moves between the page and the drawer for the same record, and returns to the default on refresh or on another record. 「放弃」 returns to the default at once; there is no Save.

This supersedes #35601's item 1 for sort ("the reader's sort is remembered per person"): the stored sort is no longer read (old rows are not deleted here). Column widths are not part of this ruling. It matches the main-list ruling on #35955 (changes are drafts; the per-person server layer goes). The PR carries "supersedes #35601's remembered sort" in its body and an upgrade note: a sort remembered in a related tab before this release no longer applies.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Maintainer ruling · 2026-11-21T14:38Z · #35892: where the related-list tab's column widths are kept (reviewed by fable first)

At 2026-11-21T14:35Z the maintainer picked option A on the seat's decision card, "browser only, folded into #35892": a related tab's column widths are remembered only in this browser, like the main list (#35955 ruling D1). This PR stops reading and writing them in the `ui.record.<object>` preference row (`RelatedList.tsx` ~1437-1457, handed to the grid ~3423, written back ~3568); the grid already keeps a browser copy. The published `RelatedListPreference` / `RecordPagePreference.relatedLists` types stay for now (removing them is a narrowing). The server's old `relatedLists` data is not cleared here: it is left unread, and the same row's `showEmptyFields` stays. The upgrade note says once that a sort or width remembered in a related tab before this release no longer applies. Sign-out keeping layout for the same person (#35955 ruling, same time) is a separate card and covers these widths too.
